runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text: OMB M-25-22 applies to any contract awarded under a solicitation issued on or after the date 180 days after the memo is issued. It also applies to any option to renew or extend the period of performance that is exercised on an existing contract after that 180-day point.

support.reason: The passage states the memo applies to any contract awarded under a solicitation issued on or after 180 days after issuance.
The passage says it applies to options to renew or extend performance period exercised on existing contracts after the 180-day date.

It also applies to any option to renew or extend the period of performance that is exercised on an existing contract after that 180-day point.
